scope.latency: Actual capability accept -> actual capability pull; lower/upper RCON bounds, not world-save latency
scope.RCON_reply_attribution: MC 1.21.1 DedicatedServer shares one RconConsoleSource output buffer across clients; concurrent commands can cross-contaminate payloads while returning the correct protocol request ID. Prefix, fixed-input and conservation checks retained; the original driver does not preserve complete raw business replies or request-specific body tags.
scope.percentiles: Every repeat retained; aggregate is median of repeat percentiles, not pooled p95
scope.business: Fixed source attempts/rounds; all acceptance and output ledger checks retained
scope.SQL: ct_dev account statement/sql events; root observer excluded; other-live-session caveat retained
scope.instrumented_counters: Actual first/final per-server status snapshots supply worker task, batch, Sql-helper and WAL differences. Absent counters are UNMEASURED. local_credit_publications includes cross delivery, so topology/event ledgers must establish source path.
scope.WAL_barriers: Per-server ring percentile snapshots are diagnostic and not phase-wide latency. No subtraction or pooling of JVM percentiles; baseline WAL absent.
scope.conservation: Latest cumulative per reused channel, not sum of repeat cumulative figures; SQL/WAL/local copies never added
scope.topology: Overworld console fixtures may share one chunk. NeighborPump skips neighboring Tesseracts. Different chunks/dimensions/real chests require separate correctness tests.
scope.unmeasured: No fabricated absent runs, failed-run performance success, phase-wide WAL timing, uncollected early-repeat MC tick means or actual TPS

captured_counter_window.scope: Actual per-server first/final ct_test status read intervals; includes ambient JVM work between reads. No new observations or timing interpolation.

scope_notes.transactions: Completed backend worker tasks; not database commits. Use db_transactions for successful SQL transactions.
scope_notes.db_statements: Instrumented Sql.query/update call attempts, including retries/failures; excludes JDBC transaction controls and statements outside those helpers. Distinct from account-wide performance_schema events.
scope_notes.batch_devices: Device appearances processed by batch calls; not a count of distinct fixture endpoints.
scope_notes.batch_records: Records processed by batch calls; not a count of SQL statements or external business events.
scope_notes.local_credit_publications: Includes credits delivered after cross-server SQL allocation; cannot identify same-server-source fast-path hits.
scope_notes.WAL: Absent keys are UNMEASURED, never zero. Writes/bytes are independent cost counters; no SQL/WAL/local resource copies are added.
